title: Cache Service Unavailable
likely_root_cause: Redis memory exhaustion exceeding maxmemory limit causing connection refusals and latency spikes
diagnostic_steps: Check Redis/Memcached cluster node health and replication lag.
Inspect memory utilization and evictions rate on cache nodes.
Inspect network throughput and TCP connection count to cache cluster.
Verify whether application fallback to primary database is holding without overwhelming DB.
recommended_remediation: If cache memory is exhausted, flush non-critical cache namespaces or increase node memory.
Trigger master failover to replica if primary node is unresponsive.
Enable local in-memory fallback cache in application instances to alleviate pressure.
Verify cache hit ratio returns to >90% before closing incident.
